title: 变形
asks: 容器身份连续时，改的是宽、高、圆角，还是排版？停在展开态还是沿路收回？
asksEn: When a container keeps its identity, does it change width, height, radius, or layout — and does it hold the expanded state or reverse along the same path?
summary: 同一入口连续变形。先定改宽、高、圆角还是排版；停在展开态，或沿原路收回——内容先走，容器后收。
summaryEn: The same entry morphs in place. First decide whether it changes width, height, radius, or layout; then whether it holds the expanded state, or reverses along the same path — content leaves first, the container follows.

links.when: 同一容器变形不是新开一层
links.whenEn: a continuous morph is not a new overlay
a continuous morph is not advancing frames
it is not a rail that occupies width
